group.name: Pascal
group.docs: Configuration options related to Object Pascal input

option.docs: The \c PASCAL_DIALECT tag selects the Object Pascal dialect used when parsing the input files (compiler defines, language mode and keywords).

The \c PASCAL_PLATFORM tag selects the target platform whose conditional symbols (MSWINDOWS, LINUX, CPUX64, ...) are defined while parsing. Additional symbols can be defined with ef cfg_predefined "PREDEFINED".

The \c PASCAL_UNIT_SCOPES tag lists the unit scope names (the compiler's UNITSCOPENAME) that are tried in front of a unit name, so that Classes can refer to System.Classes in documentation links and uses clauses.
If the \c PASCAL_XMLDOC tag is set to \c YES then DoxyPas will also interpret XML documentation comments (/// with , , ...) as used by the Delphi Help Insight.
If the \c PASCAL_PARSE_DFM tag is set to \c YES then DoxyPas will read .dfm and .fmx files and document the component tree of each form.
The \c DELPHI_PROJECT tag can be used to specify .dpr, .dpk or .dproj files from which the source files, search paths and conditional defines are taken.
